label: S2_03_Reservas&Capital
code_lines: /*ACTUALIZA CONTRAGENTE EN RESERVA DE FONDO DE PENSIONES DEL SECTOR 412 DE CA 9 A 511*/
update tablas.BD_CTSI set C_CAGENTE='511',PROC='0160' where C_CAGENTE='9' and SECTOR=412 AND C_SCN='AF.612';
/*AF62 DEL PASIVO DEL SECTOR 352 LO ASIGNA AL ACTIVO DE LOS SECTORES 321(20%),51022(45%),41(2%) Y 511(33%)*/
/*AF62 CONTRA ACTIVO DE SECTORES 41 Y 321 EN INST AF71 CON CA 352 DEBIDO A IMPUTACIONES ANTERIORES*/
WHERE (T1.C_SCN='AF.62' AND SECTOR IN(41,321) AND C_ENTRADA='D' AND FUENTE='PS')
/*CALCULA VALOR DE MERCADO DEL ACTIVO DE LOS HOLDINGS Y CASAS MATRICES CON BANCOS*/
SELECT 'P' AS MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, T1.C_CAGENTE,t1.C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN,'VM' AS FUENTE, '0300' AS PROC,
WHERE (T1.AÑO=T2.AÑO AND T1.TRIM=T2.TRIM AND T1.SECTOR=T2.SECTOR AND T1.C_CAGENTE=T2.C_CAGENTE and T1.C_ENTRADA=T2.C_ENTRADA AND T1.C_CUENTA=T2.C_CUENTA and T1.C_SCN=T2.C_SCN)
GROUP BY t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, T1.C_CAGENTE,t1.C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN,CALCULATED FUENTE,CALCULATED PROC;QUIT;
PROC SQL;/*REC PRECIO POR AJUSTAR A MERCADO*/
SELECT T1.MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, T1.C_CAGENTE,'Rec Precio' AS C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN,T1.FUENTE, '0303' AS PROC,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.C_CUENTA='Bce Inicio' THEN T1.DATO*-1 ELSE T1.DATO END) AS DATO
FROM WORK.VM_AF5_HC_D t1 GROUP BY T1.MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, T1.C_CAGENTE,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN,T1.FUENTE,CALCULATED PROC;QUIT;
PROC SQL; DROP TABLE WORK.VM_AF5_HC_D; DROP TABLE WORK.VM_AF5_HC_RP;QUIT;
/*IMPUTA INVERSIONES EN AF5 DE HOLDINGS Y CASAS MATRICES ENTRE EL SECTOR USANDO INFO DEL PATRIMONIO DE ESTAS MISMAS A VALOR LIBRO. AJUSTA IMPUTACIÓN EN CA 2.*/
PROC SQL;/*PATRIMONIO VM DE 37 Y 36907 CON CA 37 Y 36907*/
SELECT 'P' AS MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, T1.C_CAGENTE,t1.C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN,SUM(T1.DATO) AS DATO
FROM TABLAS.BD_CTSI t1 WHERE T1.C_SCN='AF.5' AND T1.SECTOR IN (37,36907) AND T1.C_CAGENTE IN ('37','36907') AND T1.C_ENTRADA='H'
PROC SQL;/*lleva vm anterior a valor libro en balances*/
WHERE (T1.AÑO=T2.AÑO AND T1.TRIM=T2.TRIM AND T1.SECTOR=T2.SECTOR AND T1.C_CAGENTE=T2.C_CAGENTE and T1.C_ENTRADA=T2.C_ENTRADA AND T1.C_CUENTA=T2.C_CUENTA and T1.C_SCN=T2.C_SCN);QUIT;
PROC SQL;/*RESTA EFECTO VALOR LIBRO DE RP*/
SELECT T1.MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, T1.C_CAGENTE,'Rec Precio' AS C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN,SUM(CASE WHEN T1.C_CUENTA='Bce Inicio' THEN T1.DATO*-1 ELSE T1.DATO END) AS DATO
FROM WORK.VL_AF5_HC_P t1 GROUP BY T1.MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, T1.C_CAGENTE,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN;QUIT;
DATA WORK.VM_AF5_HC_P;SET WORK.VM_AF5_HC_P WORK.VL_AF5_HC_P WORK.RP_AF5_HC_P;RUN;/*JUNTA BASES PARA PODER CALCULAR DIFERENCIAL A VALOR LIBRO A IMPUTAR EN ACTIVO DE 37 Y 36907*/
PROC SQL;/*AGRUPA TABLA ANTERIOR CON BALANCES A VALOR LIBRO*/
SELECT T1.MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,INPUT(T1.C_CAGENTE,BEST5.) AS SECTOR,LEFT(PUT(T1.SECTOR,CHAR5.)) AS C_CAGENTE,t1.C_CUENTA,'D' AS C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN,SUM(T1.DATO) AS DATO
FROM WORK.VM_AF5_HC_P t1 GROUP BY T1.MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, T1.C_CAGENTE,t1.C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN;QUIT;
PROC SQL;/*INV AF5 DE 37 Y 36907 CON CA 37 Y 36907*/
SELECT 'P' AS MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, T1.C_CAGENTE,t1.C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN,SUM(T1.DATO)*-1 AS DATO
FROM TABLAS.BD_CTSI t1 WHERE T1.C_SCN='AF.5' AND T1.SECTOR IN (37,36907) AND T1.C_CAGENTE IN ('37','36907') AND T1.C_ENTRADA='D'
/*CALCULA DELTA DE INVERSIONES A IMPUTAR EN 37 Y 36907, RESPECTIVAMENTE*/
PROC SQL;/*INV AF5 DE 37 Y 36907 CON CA 37 Y 36907*/
SELECT T1.MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, T1.C_CAGENTE,t1.C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN,SUM(T1.DATO) AS DATO,'PS' AS FUENTE, '0304' AS PROC
FROM WORK.AG_AF5_HC_P t1 GROUP BY T1.MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, T1.C_CAGENTE,t1.C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN;QUIT;
PROC SQL; DELETE FROM WORK.IMP_AF5_HC_HC WHERE DATO=0;QUIT;
PROC SQL;/*AJUSTA IMPUTACIÓN ANTERIOR EN 37 Y 36907 CON CA 2*/
SELECT T1.MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR,'2' as C_CAGENTE,t1.C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN,SUM(T1.DATO)*-1 AS DATO,'PS' AS FUENTE, '0304b' AS PROC
FROM WORK.IMP_AF5_HC_HC t1 GROUP BY T1.MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, T1.C_CAGENTE,t1.C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN ;QUIT;
PROC SQL; DROP TABLE WORK.VM_AF5_HC_P;DROP TABLE WORK.VL_AF5_HC_P;DROP TABLE WORK.RP_AF5_HC_P;DROP TABLE WORK.AG_AF5_HC_P;DROP TABLE WORK.INV_AF5_HC_HC;DROP TABLE WORK.IMP_AF5_HC_HC;
/*CALCULA VALOR DE MERCADO DEL ACTIVO DE LOS HOLDINGS Y CASAS MATRICES CON HOLDINGS Y CASAS MATRICES*/
SELECT 'P' AS MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, T1.C_CAGENTE,t1.C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN,'VM' AS FUENTE, '0304c' AS PROC,SUM((T1.DATO*T2.DATO)-T1.DATO) AS DATO
WHERE (T1.AÑO=T2.AÑO AND T1.TRIM=T2.TRIM AND T1.SECTOR=INPUT(T2.C_CAGENTE,BEST5.) AND T1.C_CAGENTE=LEFT(PUT(T2.SECTOR,CHAR6.)) AND T1.C_CUENTA=T2.C_CUENTA and T1.C_SCN=T2.C_SCN)
AND T1.C_ENTRADA='D' AND T1.SECTOR IN (37,36907) AND T1.C_CAGENTE IN ('37','36907')
GROUP BY t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, T1.C_CAGENTE,t1.C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN,CALCULATED FUENTE,CALCULATED PROC;QUIT;
PROC SQL;/*REC PRECIO POR AJUSTAR A MERCADO*/
SELECT T1.MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, T1.C_CAGENTE,'Rec Precio' AS C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN,T1.FUENTE, '0304c' AS PROC,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.C_CUENTA='Bce Inicio' THEN T1.DATO*-1 ELSE T1.DATO END) AS DATO
FROM WORK.VM_AF5_HC_INTRA t1 GROUP BY T1.MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, T1.C_CAGENTE,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN,T1.FUENTE,CALCULATED PROC;QUIT;
PROC SQL; DROP TABLE WORK.VM_AF5_HC_INTRA; DROP TABLE WORK.RP_AF5_HC_INTRA;QUIT;
/*IMPUTA INVERSIONES EN AF5 DE HOLDINGS Y CASAS MATRICES CON EMPRESAS SUPERVISADAS USANDO INFO DEL PATRIMONIO DE EMPRESAS A VALOR LIBRO. AJUSTA IMPUTACIÓN EN CA 2.*/
PROC SQL;/*PATRIMONIO VM DE 51021/5101  CON CA  37 Y 36907*/
SELECT 'P' AS MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, T1.C_CAGENTE,t1.C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN,SUM(T1.DATO) AS DATO
FROM TABLAS.BD_CTSI t1 WHERE T1.C_SCN='AF.5' AND T1.SECTOR IN (51021,5101) AND T1.C_CAGENTE IN ('37','36907') AND T1.C_ENTRADA='H'
PROC SQL;/*lleva vm anterior a valor libro en balances*/
WHERE (T1.AÑO=T2.AÑO AND T1.TRIM=T2.TRIM AND T1.SECTOR=T2.SECTOR AND T1.C_CAGENTE=T2.C_CAGENTE AND T1.C_CUENTA=T2.C_CUENTA);QUIT;
PROC SQL;/*RESTA EFECTO VALOR LIBRO DE RP*/
SELECT T1.MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, T1.C_CAGENTE,'Rec Precio' AS C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN,SUM(CASE WHEN T1.C_CUENTA='Bce Inicio' THEN T1.DATO*-1 ELSE T1.DATO END) AS DATO
FROM WORK.VL_AF5_HC_EMP t1 GROUP BY T1.MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, T1.C_CAGENTE,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN;QUIT;
DATA WORK.VM_AF5_HC_EMP;SET WORK.VM_AF5_HC_EMP WORK.VL_AF5_HC_EMP WORK.RP_AF5_HC_EMP;RUN;/*JUNTA BASES PARA PODER CALCULAR DIFERENCIAL A VALOR LIBRO A IMPUTAR EN ACTIVO DE 37 Y 36907*/
PROC SQL;/*AGRUPA TABLA ANTERIOR CON BALANCES A VALOR LIBRO*/
SELECT T1.MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,INPUT(T1.C_CAGENTE,BEST5.) AS SECTOR,LEFT(PUT(T1.SECTOR,CHAR5.)) AS C_CAGENTE,t1.C_CUENTA,'D' AS C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN,SUM(T1.DATO) AS DATO
FROM WORK.VM_AF5_HC_EMP t1 GROUP BY T1.MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, T1.C_CAGENTE,t1.C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN;QUIT;
PROC SQL;/*INV AF5 DE 37 Y 36907 CON CA 51021/5101*/
SELECT 'P' AS MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, T1.C_CAGENTE,t1.C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN,SUM(T1.DATO)*-1 AS DATO
FROM TABLAS.BD_CTSI t1 WHERE T1.C_SCN='AF.5' AND T1.SECTOR IN (37,36907) AND T1.C_CAGENTE IN ('51021','5101') AND T1.C_ENTRADA='D'
/*CALCULA DELTA DE INVERSIONES A IMPUTAR EN 37 Y 36907, RESPECTIVAMENTE*/
PROC SQL;/*INV AF5 DE 37 Y 36907 CON CA 37 Y 36907*/
SELECT T1.MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, T1.C_CAGENTE,t1.C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN,SUM(T1.DATO) AS DATO,'PS' AS FUENTE, '0305' AS PROC
FROM WORK.AG_AF5_HC_EMP t1 GROUP BY T1.MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, T1.C_CAGENTE,t1.C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN;QUIT;
PROC SQL; DELETE FROM WORK.IMP_AF5_HC_EMP WHERE DATO=0;QUIT;
PROC SQL;/*AJUSTA IMPUTACIÓN ANTERIOR EN 37 Y 36907 CON CA 2*/
SELECT T1.MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR,'2' as C_CAGENTE,t1.C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN,SUM(T1.DATO)*-1 AS DATO,'PS' AS FUENTE, '0305b' AS PROC
FROM WORK.IMP_AF5_HC_EMP t1 GROUP BY T1.MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, T1.C_CAGENTE,t1.C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN ;QUIT;
PROC SQL; DROP TABLE VM_AF5_HC_EMP;DROP TABLE VL_AF5_HC_EMP;DROP TABLE RP_AF5_HC_EMP;DROP TABLE AG_AF5_HC_EMP;DROP TABLE WORK.INV_AF5_HC_EMP;DROP TABLE WORK.IMP_AF5_HC_EMP;
/*CALCULA VALOR DE MERCADO DEL ACTIVO DE LOS HOLDINGS Y CASAS MATRICES CON EMPRESAS SUPERVISADAS*/
SELECT 'P' AS MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, T1.C_CAGENTE,t1.C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN,'VM' AS FUENTE, '0305c' AS PROC,SUM((T1.DATO*T2.RATIO)-T1.DATO) AS DATO
WHERE (T1.AÑO=T2.AÑO AND T1.TRIM=T2.TRIM AND T1.SECTOR=INPUT(T2.C_CAGENTE,BEST5.) AND T1.C_CAGENTE=LEFT(PUT(T2.SECTOR,CHAR6.)) AND T1.C_CUENTA=T2.C_CUENTA)
AND T1.C_ENTRADA='D' AND T1.SECTOR IN (37,36907) AND T1.C_CAGENTE IN ('51021','5101') AND T1.C_SCN='AF.5' /*CIERRE 2021: FALTABA INGRESAR COMO FILTRO EL C_SCN*/
GROUP BY t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, T1.C_CAGENTE,t1.C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN,CALCULATED FUENTE,CALCULATED PROC;QUIT;
PROC SQL;/*REC PRECIO POR AJUSTAR A MERCADO*/
SELECT T1.MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, T1.C_CAGENTE,'Rec Precio' AS C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN,T1.FUENTE, '0305c' AS PROC,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.C_CUENTA='Bce Inicio' THEN T1.DATO*-1 ELSE T1.DATO END) AS DATO
FROM WORK.VM_AF5_HC_ES t1 GROUP BY T1.MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR, T1.C_CAGENTE,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN,T1.FUENTE,CALCULATED PROC;QUIT;
PROC SQL; DROP TABLE WORK.VM_AF5_HC_ES; DROP TABLE WORK.RP_AF5_HC_ES;QUIT;
